scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace=packages/core || (echo '❌ Core build failed — fix errors in packages/core/ before starting dev' && exit 1)
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n core,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:check: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['packages/core/dist/index.js', 'packages/core/dist/client.js', 'apps/cli/dist/index.js']; const missing = files.filter(f => !fs.existsSync(f)); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing build outputs:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('All build outputs verified.')"
scripts.test:ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:check && npm run build --workspace=website && npm run test:coverage
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build --workspace=website
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cli && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/core/node_modules apps/web/node_modules apps/cli/node_modules
